ありがとうございました！

https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/15ZEqgk_Kn7FiUr0IxunHua1rDNDEcLze

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18PI6qEc8jvo0TKVWdyIxWiUT48Hbf8Jv
